scope.summary: Windows iam_token test: the marker temp path embedded in a TOML basic string is forward-slashed so a Windows path (C:\Users\...) no longer parses as an invalid \U unicode escape; mirrors coreutil() in the same file, no-op on Unix.
out_of_scope: the runtime IAM token inject logic (unchanged; only the test-side TOML path rendering was corrected)

entry_points.name: iam_token TOML-embedded marker path rendering
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp-core/src/iam_token.rs now renders the marker path with marker.display().to_string().replace('\\', "/") before embedding it in the TOML profile; the marker PathBuf keeps native form for the exists() check. Exercised by the inject/process-with-marker iam_token tests via cargo test -p oraclemcp-core (green on the Windows CI lane at HEAD f1d1d223).

limitations: Scoped regression proof only; Windows-lane green is asserted by CI at HEAD f1d1d223, not re-run locally in this close.
